title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - English Studies - Word Choice
subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The government introduced family ________ programs to help couples manage childbirth spacing.
questions.explain: 'Family planning' is the correct term used for services that help couples determine the number and spacing of their children.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

For consumer protection, buyers are advised to always check the ________ date before purchasing any canned food.
questions.explain: The term 'expiry date' is the standard designation used on consumer products to indicate when an item is no longer safe to use or eat.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Standing to recite the pledge and showing respect for the national flag is a sign of true ________.
questions.explain: 'Patriotism' refers to the feeling of love, devotion, and a sense of attachment to one's country.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Washing dishes, sweeping the compound, and cooking are classic examples of ________ chores.
questions.explain: Chores related to running a home or family are termed 'domestic' chores.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Using ________ materials instead of plastics can greatly reduce long-term environmental pollution.
questions.explain: In an environmental context, 'biodegradable' substances can be decomposed by bacteria or other living organisms, preventing pollution. Plastics are mostly non-biodegradable.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Modern advocates for gender parity are striving tirelessly to build an ________ society where both men and women have equitable access to wealth, status, and political power.
questions.explain: 'Egalitarian' means believing in or based on the principle that all people are equal and deserve equal rights and opportunities, which fits perfectly with discussions on gender issues.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The consumer protection task force rapidly confiscated thousands of cartons of ________ baby milk that had been lethally mixed with cheap chalk powder by fraudulent merchants.
questions.explain: To adulterate something means to render it poorer in quality by deliberately adding another (often inferior or dangerous) substance. Thus, the milk was 'adulterated'.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

To rapidly diminish rising unemployment, the state dramatically expanded its ________ training institutes, explicitly prioritizing hands-on courses in advanced carpentry, modern plumbing, and fashion design.
questions.explain: 'Vocational' education and training emphasize practical, hands-on skills required for a specific job, trade, or craft, unlike purely academic studies.
questions.subject: English Studies
